title: Azure Data Factory Failures by Pipeline
app: Azure Data Factory diagnostics via Azure Monitor/Event Hub and the ADF REST API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=azure:datafactory status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by pipeline_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Azure Data Factory failures grouped by pipeline so operators immediately see which specific pipelines are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Azure Data Factory is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Azure Data Factory failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical pipelines.
visualization: Table of pipeline by failure count and last failure time.

references.title: Azure Data Factory — Monitor with Azure Monitor

grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Azure Data Factory are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
